mapper.select: SELECT id, member_id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, status, create_time, update_time FROM dms_shop_address WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT id, member_id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, status, create_time, update_time FROM dms_shop_address WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 1 AND is_default = 1 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, member_id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, status, create_time, update_time FROM dms_shop_address WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_address (member_id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{detailAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_address SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, province = #{province}, city = #{city}, district = #{district}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND member_id = #{memberId}
